limits: The original macOS CI case and signal timing remain unproven. The induced 1-second sender delay reproduces false failure after completed generation, establishing a timing-test weakness, not the original CI root cause.

The new checkpoint qualifies cancellation at a private generation boundary. It does not inject at every internal loop iteration or every allocation site. The existing native loops and installation policy were not otherwise changed.

This report reviews the exact host installation and focused gate only. It is not a Windows or minimum-R execution result, a complete package gate, or qualification of the unchanged Stage 5 performance candidate.
No new R tests, signals or benchmarks were executed by this reviewer. Existing retained products and bound inputs were independently rehashed.
source_assessment: One-shot native mode is copied and cleared before any native validation. Invalid setter values clear prior state. Zero mode adds no allocation or polling and leaves normal generation behavior intact.

Interrupt checks occur after private numeric compact backing, double vector or character vector preparation and before return/install. PROTECT roots remain live at the checkpoint and R interrupt unwind drops those roots; no table slot or reference marker has been installed.
Scoped helper clears injection on any R unwind before native entry. Retry deliberately occurs without rearming or clearing first, checking native one-shot consumption.

The seven cases preserve the five original compact numeric/character/dictionary branches and add explicit double first/existing paths. Checks include serialized table and alias equality, names, reference class/environment identity, dictionary source compactness/cache, successful retry values and alias names.

Mode 1 invokes the native R interrupt handler deterministically, including Windows. Separate POSIX mode waits in the private native checkpoint after flushing a readiness marker; the parent sends one SIGINT for each distinct ready case. CPU and outer wall deadlines fail rather than infer overlap from a fixed sleep.
